title: Expenses
description: Expenses from cash, card and Click accounts. Each expense reduces its account balance.
methodLocked: The payment method cannot be changed — delete the expense and enter it again
cashHint: This comes out of the branch register and is counted when it closes
deleteDescription: {amount} — {category}, {date}. The amount is restored to its account. The record remains visible to administrators.
categoryRemoveHint: A removed category leaves the list, but past expenses keep their label.
accountHint: This amount is deducted from the {method} account and included in the shift report.
shiftRequired: Open a cashier shift before recording an expense.
